name: Panicle
author: E. T. Carter
description: A stand of pampas plumes at close range — tall curved stems carrying feathery FBM-streaked heads in varied palette hues, glowing vividly with a fine seed-fluff drifting up and downwind through the air around them. When a gust combs through, streaks of light run lengthwise to the feathered fringe while the heads stream downwind and the stems bow late with a soft overshoot, the floating fluff shimmering between fronts.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often combing gust fronts stream through the plumes and surge the streak-glow.

params.label: Comb
params.effect: How far the fibers stretch downwind and how hard the streak-glow surges through the head during a gust.

params.label: Fiber scale
params.effect: CSS-pixel wavelength of the fiber texture, from silky-fine to coarse and strawlike.

params.label: Plume height
params.effect: Height of the plumes, from low tufts to tall pampas spires filling the frame.

params.label: Seed fluff
params.effect: Density of the drifting seed-fluff particles in the air — 0 leaves bare plumes, high fills the frame with floating pollen and fluff.
